verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an AI plugin and a built-in LLM chat that can run commands, so plugging in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions MCP client support or any way to connect external tool servers to the AI chat. The Python API and triggers are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
